📖 How to use

  1. Enter a date and latitude to auto-compute sunrise/sunset — or type them manually.
  2. Add longitude + UTC offset for local clock times.
  3. Press Calculate.
  4. Read your morning and evening golden-hour windows.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is golden hour?

Golden hour is roughly the first hour after sunrise and the last hour before sunset, when the sun is low and light is warm and soft.

Do I need my sunrise and sunset times?

Enter a date and latitude and the tool derives sunrise/sunset with solar equations. Or type your own sunrise/sunset times directly.

Does it work near the poles?

Yes — near the poles in summer/winter there may be no sunrise/sunset, and the tool will say so instead of guessing.
